name: Costers del Segre

known.via: English Wikipedia "Costers del Segre" (a wine place on Wikidata)

communes: Gimenells I El Pla De La Font

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A Catalan DO in Lleida province, split into seven sub-zones: Artesa, Urgell, Les Garrigues, Pallars, Raimat, Segrià and Valls del Riu Corb. The allowed grape list is long and varied, from Tempranillo, Garnacha Tinta and Cabernet Sauvignon to Chardonnay, Macabeo and Riesling.
